pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 3.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we make use of the library resources well?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe key practices for effective library use
2. respond to texts related to the theme for information

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe key practices for effective library use
   In simple words: practise until you can describe key practices for effective library use. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. respond to texts related to the theme for information
   In simple words: practise until you can respond to texts related to the theme for information. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills.
4. Show that you can: describe key practices for effective library use

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library skills important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Work with peers to discuss key considerations when using the library,
2. Conduct a silent reading session to read resources and grade appropriate texts,
3. Prepare a reading log with details of the texts read (e.g. title, author, characters, setting, summary of events) for future reference,
4. Citizenship: The learner accumulates varied reading resources on people who have served their communities well and successfully.
5. Critical thinking and Problem-solving: The learner explores views when discussing key considerations when using the library. Values:

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we make use of the library resources well?
2. How have you engaged yourself in serving your community and society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe key practices for effective library use
2. respond to texts related to the theme for information

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
